name: Sayuri
source:
The latest girl J has trained. Because of J's training, she has become a nymphomaniac who always seeks for sexual contact from J. She is rarely allowed to wear clothing, even in the company of others.

Although she wishes she could have J all for herself, she encourages Yamame to have sex with J because she wants Yamame to be happy.
